BCCI Meeting to Discuss Player Futures and Team Strategy

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) held a review meeting where selectors were expected to discuss the future of senior players, including Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, and Ravindra Jadeja, in One Day Internationals (ODIs) concerning the upcoming World Cup. Gautam Gambhir and Shubman Gill were reported to have arrived at the headquarters for discussions. Potential major announcements regarding player futures were anticipated.
